mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalAssets, COUNT(DISTINCT hai.host_id) AS totalHosts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hai.port IS NOT NULL THEN hai.port END) AS distinctPorts, COUNT(CASE WHEN hai.product IS NOT NULL AND hai.product != '' AND UPPER(hai.product) != 'UNMATCHED' THEN 1 END) AS identifiedAssets, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hai.product IS NOT NULL AND hai.product != '' THEN hai.product END) AS distinctProducts FROM host_asset_inventory hai WHERE hai.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (hai.deleted = 0 OR hai.deleted IS NULL)

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS name, CONCAT( COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)), CASE WHEN h.ipv4 IS NOT NULL AND h.ipv4 != '' THEN CONCAT(' / ', h.ipv4) ELSE '' END ) AS secondary, COUNT(1) AS count FROM host_asset_inventory hai JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hai.host_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT host_id, MAX(updated_at) AS max_updated_at FROM host_asset_inventory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY host_id ) latest_time ON hai.host_id = latest_time.host_id AND hai.updated_at = latest_time.max_updated_at INNER JOIN ( SELECT host_id, updated_at, MAX(task_id) AS task_id FROM host_asset_inventory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY host_id, updated_at ) latest_task ON hai.host_id = latest_task.host_id AND hai.updated_at = latest_task.updated_at AND hai.task_id = latest_task.task_id WHERE hai.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (hai.deleted = 0 OR hai.deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY h.id, h.ipv4, h.hostname, h.mac_address ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(latest_ports.port AS CHAR) AS name, COALESCE(NULLIF(latest_ports.protocol, ''), 'tcp') AS secondary, COUNT(1) AS count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT latest.host_id, latest.port, latest.protocol FROM host_asset_inventory latest INNER JOIN ( SELECT host_id, MAX(updated_at) AS max_updated_at FROM host_asset_inventory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND port IS NOT NULL AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY host_id ) latest_time ON latest.host_id = latest_time.host_id AND latest.updated_at = latest_time.max_updated_at INNER JOIN ( SELECT host_id, updated_at, MAX(task_id) AS task_id FROM host_asset_inventory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND port IS NOT NULL AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY host_id, updated_at ) latest_task ON latest.host_id = latest_task.host_id AND latest.updated_at = latest_task.updated_at AND latest.task_id = latest_task.task_id WHERE latest.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND latest.port IS NOT NULL AND (latest.deleted = 0 OR latest.deleted IS NULL) ) latest_ports GROUP BY latest_ports.port, latest_ports.protocol ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC, latest_ports.port ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(hai.category, 'unknown')) IN ('webapp', 'website', 'webframework') THEN 'Web' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(hai.category, 'unknown')) IN ('database', 'db') THEN 'DB' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(hai.category, 'unknown')) IN ('middleware', 'service', 'bigdata') THEN 'Middleware' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM host_asset_inventory hai WHERE hai.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (hai.deleted = 0 OR hai.deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(hai.category, 'unknown')) IN ('webapp', 'website', 'webframework') THEN 'Web' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(hai.category, 'unknown')) IN ('database', 'db') THEN 'DB' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(hai.category, 'unknown')) IN ('middleware', 'service', 'bigdata') THEN 'Middleware' ELSE 'Unknown' END ORDER BY count DESC, name ASC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(hai.product, ''), 'UNMATCHED') AS name, MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(hai.category, ''), 'unknown')) AS secondary, COUNT(1) AS count FROM host_asset_inventory hai WHERE hai.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (hai.deleted = 0 OR hai.deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(hai.product, ''), 'UNMATCHED') ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC, name ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(hai.created_at, '%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(1) AS count FROM host_asset_inventory hai WHERE hai.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (hai.deleted = 0 OR hai.deleted IS NULL) AND hai.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(hai.created_at) ORDER BY DATE(hai.created_at) ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(hai.created_at, '%m-%d %H:00') AS label, COUNT(1) AS count FROM host_asset_inventory hai WHERE hai.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (hai.deleted = 0 OR hai.deleted IS NULL) AND hai.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(hai.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(hai.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ASC
